title: Robust Decision-Making with Partially Calibrated Forecasters

resolved_invalid.ac_evidence: The reviewers had several specific questions, which have been addressed.

unresolved.issue: Discussion around line 323 conflating minimax optimality with swap regret guarantee
unresolved.ac_evidence: I think the discussion around lines 323 is a bit misleading, minimax optimality with respect to all decision rules is not strictly stronger than the swap regret guarantee, since the swap regret guarantee holds at a sequence-level.

unresolved.issue: Lack of statistical significance bars for experimental results
unresolved.ac_evidence: It would be good to have some statistical significance bars for the experimental results, since the differences are small.

unresolved.issue: Optimality should be clarified as with respect to linear decision rules
unresolved.ac_evidence: I think the paper should mention that optimality is with respect to linear decision rules in the introduction.

The paper should discuss the line of work on omniprediction, since it aims to provide the same guarantee of the optimal downstream decision rule being the one corresponding to the ground-truth probabilities.
